intro.narration: [excited] How do you solve twelve times twenty-three by just drawing lines? Watch.

steps.narration: [curious] Twelve times twenty-three. No times tables, no long multiplication.
[confident] Draw each digit as that many lines. One number slants this way, the other crosses it.
steps.instruction: Draw each digit as that many lines, one number each way

steps.narration: [curious] Now count the crossings in each diagonal band. Two, seven, six.
steps.instruction: Count the crossings in each diagonal band

steps.narration: [excited] Each band is what a column of the sum would hold. Read them off. Two hundred seventy-six.
steps.instruction: Each band is the digit product a column would hold

steps.narration: [thoughtful] One catch. A band of ten or more carries left, so four, ten, six is really five hundred six. [warm] Try your own.
steps.instruction: A band of 10 or more carries left
